description: This Java class 'FedexServices' provides implementations for interacting with FedEx shipping APIs, including methods for sending shipping requests and subscription requests, both via HTTP and template rendering. It defines constants, imports necessary utilities, and performs operations such as address validation, package dimension processing, and API response handling within the context of a larger shipment management framework.

classes.name: FedexServices
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to interact with FedEx shipment APIs, including request handling, address validation, package dimension processing, and response parsing.

methods.name: sendFedexRequest
methods.description: Sends an XML request to FedEx via HTTP POST and returns the XML response as a string. Performs URL and XML header validation, configures timeout, and handles errors during connection.

methods.name: fedexSubscriptionRequest
methods.description: Handles the registration of a FedEx account for shipping, including address validation, retrieving contact details, rendering a subscription XML template, sending the request, and parsing the response to extract the meter number.

methods.name: fedexShipRequest
methods.description: Prepares and sends a FedEx shipment request, including validation of shipment and address details, package dimension and weight calculation, rendering of the shipment XML template, and processing the API response.

methods.name: handleFedexShipReply
methods.description: Extracts tracking number and label image from the FedEx shipment reply XML, decodes label image, stores it, updates shipment segment data, and handles errors.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Processes the XML root element to detect and record error messages from the FedEx API responses.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the FedEx shipment gateway from the database or properties, with optional default value.
